name: Write DLFS File
description: Write content to a file in a DLFS drive. Creates the file if it does not exist; overwrites if it does. Parent directories must already exist — use dlfs:mkdir first if needed. Supply exactly one of 'content' (UTF-8 text), 'value' (JSON-serialisable), 'bytes' (base64 inline), or 'contentRef' (resolvable content, streamed). Large binary uploads from clients should use the WebDAV PUT transport at /dlfs/{drive}/{path} directly.
creator: Covia

value.description: JSON-serialisable value to write as UTF-8 JSON

contentRef.description: Resolvable content reference to stream, including an asset, file:// root path, or DLFS path. No size limit.

created.description: True if file was newly created
